elements.label: Figure 1.20
elements.title: Average Interest Rates on New External Debt Commitments for IDA-Eligible Countries, by Region and Creditor Type, 2015–25
legend: East Asia and Pacific (excl. China) (dark blue)
Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan (purple)
elements.description: Two panels show regional average interest rates on new external debt commitments from official and private creditors from 2015 to 2025. Official-creditor rates are generally lower than private-creditor rates. The highest plotted private-creditor rate is approximately 14.3 percent for Latin America and the Caribbean in 2023; its lowest is approximately 0.5 percent for the same region in 2017. In 2025, official-creditor rates were highest in Latin America and the Caribbean and lowest in Sub-Saharan Africa.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
